invariants.rationale: The method assumes that layer is valid and used throughout; a null layer would result in NullPointerException.
A TiledMapTileLayer should not have a negative width; this property is necessary for correct rendering calculations.
A TiledMapTileLayer should not have a negative height, necessary for array/loop index boundaries in rendering.
Tile width should be strictly positive for computation of layout and rendering.
Tile height should be strictly positive for rendering and layout calculations.
